answer: Seed every identity's private feed with canary facts: a unique crystal of invented details, like a fake town name or odd statistic, issued to that identity alone. Graders scan all answers; when one identity's canary surfaces in another's text, the protocol grows a vine linking the two. Linked groups share one reward, and each further link tightens a spiral that locks the group's stakes for another season. A farm must give every clone fully separate memory and tooling, since one leaked canary binds them all and each added clone is one more leak path.
